description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Dragon], [Damage Cap +10000], [Jump Quick Cast] and [Freya Trance] to the user

description.name: Awoken Dragon
description.text: Dragoon and Dancer abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Trance Lancer after using Dragoon and Dancer abilities

description.name: Trance Lancer
description.text: Three single ranged attacks (1.51 each), restores 1000 HP to all allies every second activation

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Jump Quick Cast
description.text: Cast speed x2.00 for Jump attacks

description.name: Freya Trance
description.text: ATK and RES +30%, casts Undying Love after using a Dragoon Jump ability

description.name: Undying Love
description.text: Three single ranged attacks (0.37 each), 100% hit rate
